newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Lacey, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Lacey, N.J..

text.p: The Board of Education of The Township of Lacey

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board Secretary of The Board of Education of the Township of Lacey, in the County of Ocean, New Jersey at the Board's administrative offices (in the conference room), located at 200 Western Boulevard, Lanoka Harbor, New Jersey on
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the following Bonds of the School District due (subject to prior redemption) on November 1 in each of the years as follows:

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the opt ion of the Board in accordance with terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Board will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Wilentz, Goldman & Spitzer, P.A., Woodbridge, New Jersey. The Bonds will be dated November 1, 1996 and will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum specified by the successful bidder in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale, payable on November 1, 1997 and semiannually thereafter on the first days of May and November in each year until maturity or earlier redemption. Each proposal submitted must specify the rate or rates of interest per annum to be borne by each maturity of the Bonds and the rate or rates named shall be in multiples of one- eighth (1/8) or one-twentieth (1/20) of one (1%) per centum. If more than one rate of interest is named, no interest rate named for any maturity may be less than the interest rate named for any prior maturity and not more than one rate of interest may be named for the Bonds of the same maturity. There is no limitation on the number of rates of interest that may be named. No proposal will be considered that offers to pay an amount less than the total principal amount of Bonds offered for sale or under which the total loan is made at an interest cost higher than the lowest net interest cost to the Board of Education under any legally acceptable proposal. Each proposal submitted must specify the purchase
price for the Bonds, which shall be not less

submitted must indicate the principal amount of Bonds the bidder will accept which shall be $16,790,000 or any lesser amount that is a multiple of $1,000, the Bonds so accepted being the first to mature. The Bonds shall be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost. Such net interest cost shall be computed, as to each bid, by adding to the total principal amount of bonds bid for, the total interest cost to maturity in accordance with such bid and by deduction therefrom of the amount of premium bid, if any. If two or more bidders offer the same lowest net interest cost, the Bonds will be sold to one of such bidders selected by the undersigned by lot from among all such bidders. The purchaser must also pay an amount equal to the interest on the Bonds accrued from the dated date of the Bonds to the date of payment of the purchase price of the Bonds. The right is reserved to reject all bids, and any bid not complying with the terms of this notice will be rejected. Each bidder is required to deposit a certified,

treasurer's or cashier's check payable to the order of THE BOARD OF EDUCATION OF THE TOWNSHIP OF LACEY, IN THE COUNTY OF OCEAN in the amount of $335,800 drawn upon a bank or trust company, and such check must be enclosed with the proposal. The full Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official

Statement and the bid forms are available by contacting the Board Secretary at The Board of Education of the Township of Lacey, 200 Western Boulevard, P.O. Box 605, Lanoka Harbor, New Jersey 08734-0605, at (609) 971-2000, or the Board of Education's Financial Advisor, Jay Darby, J.J. Darby & Co., Inc., 500 Harding Road, Red Bank, New Jersey 07701 at (908) 747-7500.
The maximum net interest cost expressed as a percentage shall not exceed 7% per Annum.
